adjudication.rationale: In `GoogleCalendarService` the diff changes from `googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials)` (which returns the parsed credentials object) to `parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema)`. But `parseRefreshTokenResponse` (new file) returns the Zod `safeParse` result object (`{ success, data, error? }`), not `data`. The subsequent `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })` would therefore persist the SafeParse wrapper instead of the credential payload, breaking the stored credential shape after the first refresh.
